name: SNMPGatherDocParts
title: SNMPGatherDocParts - Global
summary: The SNMPGatherDocParts script include provides methods to handle the gathering of parts of an SNMP response document for JavaScript SNMP sensors.
overview: Use this script include in a discovery script when you need to gather the parts of an SNMP response document.

members.name: gather
members.summary: Returns the given XML document with any data gathered by prior SNMP probes.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
doc String The XML document for this sensor
probe Object The probe instance
Returns
Type Description
String The XML document with the gathered data.
